lines.text: When the anointed priest sins, he brings a young bull and sprinkles its blood seven times before the LORD.
When the whole congregation strays unintentionally and becomes aware of it, the elders lay their hands on the bull's head.
When a leader sins unintentionally, he brings an unblemished male ram, and the priest makes atonement and he is forgiven.
A common person who sins unintentionally brings an unblemished female goat, and the priest burns its fat on the altar.
If he cannot afford a lamb, he brings two turtledoves, or else a tenth of an ephah of barley flour.
